contributions.detail: This is the 'other' typed 2020 variant, NOT the Carr form, and its cover line 1 is worded 'Total contributions from all donors' - it is NOT an over-$50 line, so the anchor keys named cover_over50_* hold the ALL-DONORS figure here; there is no separate <=$50 cover line at all (le50 keys null). The <=$50 aggregate instead appears as a labelled line INSIDE Schedule A: 'Single aggregate for all single donations of fifty dollars or less per Cache County Code 2.21.050.C.1. ... 105.00'. Per the sub-$50 rule that line is an AGGREGATE, not a transaction, and is NOT emitted as a row. So: 16 itemized rows sum to 2754.77; 2754.77 + the printed 105.00 aggregate = 2,859.77 = the schedule's printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' = cover line 1 THIS = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE. EXACT on every anchor. Independent confirmation that 2754.77 is the right over-$50 split: this filer's later Carr-form filing (key 510980e7, same chunk) prints exactly 2,754.77 on its over-$50 line and 105.00 on its <=$50 aggregate line. Scope: the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns are equal because TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT is 0.00 - this is the first report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide; recorded cumulative.

expenditures.detail: 23 rows sum to 2859.77 = the schedule's printed 'Total Campaign Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): (2,859.77)' = cover line 2 THIS = cover line 2 CUMULATIVE. First report of the cycle (LAST column 0.00), so the two scopes coincide; recorded cumulative. PARENTHESES: every amount cell on this schedule, INCLUDING the printed total, is written in accounting parentheses, and the cover restates the same figure UNparenthesized as a positive 2,859.77. The parentheses are therefore this form's uniform outflow convention, not a per-row negative sign, and amounts are emitted as positive magnitudes with the verbatim parenthesised form noted on every row. Reading them as negatives would make the schedule total -2,859.77 and contradict the cover.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows 2754.77 + printed <=$50 aggregate 105.00 = printed Total Contributions 2,859.77 (exact); p3 rows 2859.77 = printed Total Campaign Expenditures (2,859.77) (exact). Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal (each schedule is one page).
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returns geometry_status 'no-reliable-geometry' on both pages because the table is ROTATED 90 degrees inside the portrait frame, so the row rules land in v_rules, not h_rules - the tool's own row logic does not apply and I did NOT treat it as an oracle. Used its v_rules as raw rule positions instead: p2 v_rules gives 24 rules bounding exactly 23 bands = 4 title/header/shading bands + 16 data rows + the <=$50 aggregate line + the Total line, matching the 16 rows emitted. p3's rule detection is partial (9 of ~25), so p3 rows were counted by ink at 200 dpi: 23 inked data rows + 1 Total row, 23 rows emitted; the rule pitch was reconstructed (79.05 pct down to the 33.27 pct bottom border in 24 equal bands) and PROVEN by the crops below rather than assumed.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: first-row box (pct:74.86,83.50,2.49,13.29) crops to '100.00'; last-row box (pct:36.83,83.50,2.49,13.29) crops to '117.36'; control one row-pitch past the last row renders '105.00' - i.e. the printed <=$50 aggregate line, which is exactly the field deliberately NOT emitted as a row, and the grid's last real cell. p3: first-row box (pct:77.14,80.99,1.91,13.41) crops to '(100.00)'; last-row box (pct:35.18,80.99,1.91,13.41) crops to '(128.40)'; control one pitch past renders '(2,859.77)', the printed Total row, so no data row was missed below row 23. Geometry is emitted in the UN-ROTATED portrait frame poppler renders, so the amount-cell bands are TALL and NARROW (x = the row, y = the amount column).
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY: cover line 3 'Ending Balance' 0.00 + contributions 2,859.77 - expenditures 2,859.77 = 0.00, and the cover prints 0.00 in all three columns of line 3. CROSS-FILING CHAIN (this chunk holds two filings by this filer in one cycle, so the check was run): this filing's CUMULATIVE column (2,859.77 contributions / 2,859.77 expenditures / 0.00 balance) chains EXACTLY into the TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT column of the filer's later 12/03/2020 Carr filing, key 510980e7 (2,754.77 over-$50 + 105.00 aggregate = 2,859.77 contributions; 2,859.77 expenditures; 0.00 balance). Not a swapped-cover pair.

escalation_note: p2/p3 needed ROTATION before reading, not resolution: pdfinfo reports 'Page rot: 0' for all three pages, but pages 2 and 3 store the table rotated 90 degrees inside a portrait frame while page 1 is upright - per-page-block rotation exactly as the core brief warns. Rotated with PIL; the first attempt (rotate(-90)) produced an upside-down page that was still partly READABLE, which is why orientation was checked against the header/title axis rather than by legibility. Escalations proper: 3 cell crops at 1200 dpi on p2 (first row, last row, control) and 3 on p3 (first row, last row, control). One value materially changed between passes: Kelly Jaques read 50.00 on the 90 dpi contact sheet and 500.00 at 200 dpi and above - and at 500.00 the schedule sums to 2,859.77 exactly, so the arithmetic settles it.
